name: BATTLESHIP ROYALE
scope: Every answer is a hull class, a map, a rule or an arsenal token of Battleship Royale.
decoys: The other hulls, the other maps, or the other battleship tokens.

name: THE MULTIVERSE GRAND PRIX
scope: Every answer is a circuit, an engine, a length, an item box or an arsenal token of the Grand Prix.
decoys: The other circuits, engines, items, or gp_ tokens.

name: MIND THE MINES
scope: Every answer is a field level, a number or an arsenal token of Minesweeper.
decoys: The other three levels, or the other ms_ tokens.

name: WORD-CROSS
scope: Every answer is a rule, a clock, a scroll in the starter archive or a Word-Cross token.
decoys: The other starter scrolls, or the other wc_ tokens.

name: MULTIVERSE GOLF
scope: Every answer is one of the six real courses, a hole on one of them, or a rule of word golf.
decoys: The other five courses, or the other holes on that card.

name: THE CASINO FLOOR
scope: Every answer is a table on the floor, a rule of one of them, or a casino token. Never the horse race — another column owns that.
decoys: The other tables, or the other cs_ tokens.

name: AND THEY'RE OFF!
scope: Every answer is one of the seven horses (all Spades) or one of the seven bets on the race card.
decoys: The other six horses, or the other six bets — whichever family the clue is in.

name: TOKENS & ARSENALS
scope: Every answer is a token, a price, a limit or a rule from the six arsenals.
decoys: The other tokens in that game's arsenal, or the other five arsenals.

name: BELTS & BRASS
scope: Every answer is a belt on the ladder, a service branch, or a rank inside one.
decoys: The other eight belts, the other five branches, or the neighbouring ranks.

name: THE BOUNTY OFFICE
scope: Every answer is a bounty rule, bonus, tier or achievement.
decoys: The other kill tiers, the other slayer tiers, or the other bonuses.

name: THE KART GARAGE
scope: Every answer is a kart in the garage or what unlocks one.
decoys: The other karts in the KARTS list.

name: DOJO LORE
scope: Every answer is a fact about the arena as a whole — its games, its economy, its shape. Nothing a single-game column already owns.
decoys: The other games, or the other arena-wide systems.

name: BEFORE & AFTER
scope: Every answer is two known things sharing a word, run together — SILENT NIGHT FEVER.
decoys: Other run-together pairs built the same way, plausible but not the clued one.

name: POTPOURRI
scope: Every answer is an ordinary household object. The subjects roam; the answers never leave the house.
decoys: Other household objects.
note: FRAGILE. It survives only because the answers are secretly one family. The night somebody writes a clue whose answer is a person, the column breaks. Keep the rule in the data.

name: WORD ORIGINS
scope: Every answer is the language, place or trade an English word came from.
decoys: Other source languages, or other plausible origins.

name: WE THE PEOPLE
scope: Every answer is an amendment, a clause, a branch or an office of the US Constitution.
decoys: The other amendments, or the other branches and offices.

name: WORLD HISTORY
scope: Every answer is an empire, a treaty, a revolution or a ruler from world history.
decoys: Other empires, treaties or rulers of roughly the same era.

name: LITERATURE
scope: Every answer is a novel, a novelist or a character from the literary canon.
decoys: Other novels by the period, or other novelists of it.

name: SPORTS
scope: Every answer is a sport, a rule of one, a trophy or a position.
decoys: Other sports, other trophies, or the other positions in that sport.

name: COLLEGES & UNIVERSITIES
scope: Every answer is a university, its home town, its nickname or its colours.
decoys: Other universities of similar standing.

name: U.S. PRESIDENTS
scope: Every answer is a US president or something one of them did.
decoys: Other presidents, ideally from adjacent decades.

name: SHAKESPEARE
scope: Every answer is a Shakespeare play, character or line.
decoys: The other plays, or the other characters in that play.

name: FAIRY TALES

decoys: Other tales, or other characters from the same tradition.

name: STRIKE UP THE BAND

name: RHYME TIME
scope: Every answer is a rhyming pair of words meaning the clue — a FAT CAT.
decoys: Other rhyming pairs, near misses on the meaning.

name: STUPID ANSWERS
scope: Every answer is a word sitting in plain sight inside the clue.
decoys: Other words from the same clue.

name: CROSSWORD CLUES "A"
scope: Every answer begins with A and is clued the way a crossword would clue it.
decoys: Other A-words of the same length.

name: COMMON BONDS
scope: Every answer is the thing three named items have in common.
decoys: Other properties two of the three share but not the third.

name: ANAGRAMS
scope: Every answer is the word the clued letters rearrange into.
decoys: Other real words from a near-identical letter set.

name: ODD ONE OUT
scope: Every answer is the one item in a list that does not belong.

name: NAME THE DECADE
scope: Every answer is a decade.

name: STARTS & ENDS
scope: Every answer is a word starting and ending with the same letters.

name: HOMOPHONES
scope: Every answer is one of a pair of words that sound alike and are spelt differently.
decoys: The other spellings of that same sound.

name: PALINDROMES
scope: Every answer reads the same backwards.
decoys: Other palindromes of the same length.

name: QUOTABLE QUOTES
scope: Every answer is who said a famous line.
decoys: Other speakers from the same era or field.

name: ALSO KNOWN AS
